note: Descriptive only. VUS have no ground-truth label, so these predictions cannot be validated the way every other result in this project was. This summary and vus_predictions.csv are the frozen, authoritative record of this run; re-running this script after ClinVar publishes a new variant_summary.txt.gz would see a different, larger, and partly reclassified VUS pool, which is exactly why these outputs are saved rather than recomputed on demand.
